instrument: LSEG/Refinitiv GCc1 generic COMEX gold futures
target: unannualized square root of two-observation Yang-Zhang variance
hgb_distribution_note: HGB point model remains squared-error gradient boosting under both assumptions; Normal and Student-t predictive densities use errors from a chronological training-only calibration slice.
student_t_note: Student-t innovations are standardized to unit variance and degrees of freedom are estimated by maximum likelihood with df > 2.
garch_x_note: GARCH-X and EGARCH-X are re-estimated in this experiment under each likelihood. GARCH-X keeps the existing AR(1) mean, lagged OHLC range, nonnegative selected-predictor coefficients, and Gaussian special case. It is not the earlier threshold-GARCH variant. EGARCH-X is new.
conditional_variance_note: A heavier-tailed innovation does not impose constant variance of forecast errors across forecast levels. Quintile error dispersion remains a descriptive check of that pattern.
holdout_caveat: The chronological holdout was examined in earlier forecast comparisons. Scores are descriptive, not a model-selection test.
